item.tib: mdo sde me tog 'phreng ba'i bum chog zur bkod
item.coloph: ces pa'i 'phags pa'i gnas brten gyi tshogs zur bkod 'di/ tshes brgyad rgyun khyer cho ga btang sgrub/ bshos bu lha grangs bca' ru mi dgos pa/ bum pa gzhal yas la brten bca' chog pa'i zhe 'dun rtse gcig du dril ba'i o rgyan rig pa 'dzin pa'i bdag nyid rig 'dzin chen po byang chub rdo rje'i ngo slob/ dmu rigs sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis/ gnas chen ri bo rtse drug gi bla brang nas/ shing phag zla 3tshes 1la bkod pa/ nyes 'gal gang mchis drin chen lha la bshags/ dge ba'i 'gro kun byang chub sa thob shog/
